repair: preserve spatial_cancellation under its registered output name and exclude classification_stratum from numeric trajectories; no scientific contract change
zero_mass_rule: NA retained in place; required image contrast is NA; no imputation or complete-case substitution; minimum-n truth table applies
missing_intervention_rule: VALID sealed arrays remain eligible for array endpoints; absent historical deletion/ablation payload makes only A1/B6/B7 NA; no rerun or reconstruction
rng_stream_rule: Each endpoint independently initializes the frozen PCG64 seed and consumes one row-major replicate-by-image matrix in ascending image order; a two-sided endpoint reuses the same sign matrix for d-margin then -d-margin.
invalid_holm_rule: retain family member with effective p=1, adjusted p=1 and reject=false; raw p remains null
